title: DocumentManifest
description: Triage decision for one publication: is it in scope, and which individuals does it describe?

in_scope.description: True if the document describes at least one individual human with a stated/suspected/revised diagnosis in the disease scope, with phenotypic, biochemical or genetic findings.

reasons.description: One or two sentences justifying the decision.

scope_diseases_mentioned.description: Disease names in the disease scope that the document is about.

local_id.description: Identifier as used in the paper. Use 'the patient' when a single unnamed patient is described.

where.description: Anchors where this individual's data live: 'abstract', 'sec:<n>', 'tab:<n> r<i>' (row-wise) or 'tab:<n> c<j>' (column-wise).

is_affected.description: False for unaffected relatives mentioned only for context.

is_rereport.description: True if the paper states this individual was described in an earlier publication.

rereport_reference.description: Citation text or PMID of the earlier report.
